offers_products.reason: Sells DUROLANE joint injections, Exogen bone-healing ultrasound, bone graft substitutes, StimRouter and neXus surgical ultrasonic devices.

offers_services.reason: Revenue comes from medical devices and biologics; no main service offering is described.

sells_to_consumers.reason: Physicians, surgeons, clinics and hospitals choose and buy the products, with payers reimbursing; patients are only end users.

sells_to_organizations.reason: Sells to hospitals, surgeons, physician practices and payers such as Aetna Medicare Advantage; also distributors.

recurring_revenue.reason: Revenue comes from procedure-driven product sales such as injections, bone grafts and devices, not subscriptions or contracts.

cyclical_demand.reason: Fracture healing, bone grafts and osteoarthritis pain treatment are medical needs that are not easily postponed.

big_ticket.reason: Typical sales are injections, bone graft units and single-patient devices, which are small and frequent for hospitals and clinics.

people_delivered.reason: Customers pay for medical products and technology, not for staff time.

large_customers.reason: Customers are mostly physician practices, surgeons and hospitals, with payers also involved; large-enterprise focus is unclear.

asset_heavy.reason: Medical device and biologics company that depends on product development and a sales force, not plants, fleets or networks.

notes: Wound and Advanced Rehabilitation businesses were divested and are excluded. Consumer answer is borderline because patients use the products.
